results.title: One Hundred and Eighty
results.overview: The winner  of a regional women's darts final suspects her opponent of letting her win, and won't let her leave until she finds out why.

results.title: Madness - Princes of Ska, Kings of Pop
results.original_title: Madness : Prince du ska, Roi de la Pop
results.overview: From the back rooms of Camden's pubs to the roof of Buckingham Palace at Queen Elizabeth’s Jubilee: the London band Madness enriched British pop music history with their cheeky style and spectacular performances. In this documentary, we look back on their illustrious career with interviews with band members, friends, and music industry figures.  Featuring brand new recorded interviews with Suggs and Bedders from ‘Madness’. Alongside interviews with Lynval Golding, Rhoda Dakar, Clive Langer and many more.

results.title: Honey Bare
results.overview: After years of delighting fans as Honey the Bear, a beloved sports mascot must confront his identity as he prepares to leave the role behind.

results.title: Dizzy
results.overview: Dylan and Lizzy are best friends, growing up in a typical dystopian suburbia. Dylan has a plan to take her mom's boyfriend's car for the night. The two of them drop acid, steal the car, and the wild sequence of events that ensue over the next nine hours is one for the books. Dylan is all gas, no brakes. Lizzy is more in touch with the risk verses benefit equation. The unlikely duo are still inseparable, and their journey is as entertaining as it is dangerous. In the end, we are reminded that life's a trip, so enjoy the ride.

Despite the close bonds among fellow defectors, Cheol-jun—a young North Korean defector—felt isolated while hiding his gay identity. Finally, he takes his first step into South Korea's vibrant gay community and forms close ties after meeting Yeong-jun at a casual gathering. Yet, a trivial misunderstanding shatters these fragile bonds.

results.title: Stork of Hope
results.overview: In the early days of World War II, two Jewish brothers lost their parents during the Nazi invasion of Belarus. The boys were imprisoned in a German hospital and found many of their peers there. They were kept in inhuman conditions - hunger, cold, lack of sleep and rest. The only thing the boys had, their treasure - was a family portrait with mom and dad. Before the fascists separated brothers, each of them got half of it.

results.title: Cash Cash To Heaven
results.overview: After a painful breakup, an 18-year-old filmmaking student returns to his devout family’s provincial church to rediscover his faith—but while documenting church activities, he uncovers a system that appears to monetize devotion, forcing him to confront the uneasy truth about belief, power, and the price of salvation in the age of digital donations.

results.title: Neethi
results.overview: A woman gets into a relationship that ends up in domestic violence. Eager to die, she finds ways to kill herself. However, an opportunity presents itself in the form of a thief.

results.title: Hacé Algo Positivo
results.overview: Naomi, a young urban artist, fills the streets with color and her message: "Do something positive." Her art becomes an act of resistance against the incomprehension of those who want to silence her.

results.title: When the Masks Fall
results.overview: The story follows Ala, a character who infiltrates the Balandin Russian mafia family, and her tumultuous journey filled with love, revenge, ambition, and passion. It explores the uncovering of secrets hidden behind masks by characters fulfilling a mission

results.title: Emo
results.overview: BADRI invites AARYA to his house on their third date. As the conversation between them goes forward, the sexual tension builds up, they finally lean forward to kiss. - 'Emo' is all about what happens next!

results.title: Sharks
results.overview: A thief on the verge of self ruin gets his life thrown upside down when his paths cross with a professional organization.  'Sharks' is a black-and-white neo-noir drama-thriller about a man on the margins of society who becomes ensnared in a criminal underworld. What begins as petty theft spirals into a deadly moral unraveling.

results.title: Jack and Nancy
results.original_title: Jack et Nancy - Les plus belles histoires de Quentin Blake
results.overview: Jack and Nancy love to hear the local sailors tell of exciting adventures in far-off lands. One day, they are walking on the cliffs when the wind picks up and they're blown away to an exotic island.

results.title: Unvirtuous
results.overview: In Burkina Faso, against the backdrop of advancing jihadist forces, Natie, a troubled teenager, discovers that her grandmother married a man she did not love. In her quest to mend her grandmother’s shattered destiny, Natie hopes to find herself as well. But will she succeed in achieving her own emancipation?

results.title: Mrs. Weekley's Lover
results.overview: Mrs. Weekley starts an affair with a young writer named D.H. Lawrence.

results.title: Sudah
results.overview: The Manadonese Senna is about to embark on her first journey to explore her roots in Indonesia. A week before her departure, she attempts to connect with her mother Annie and other family members. Her efforts fail one by one, until she reveals a secret. Will Senna be able to break through her mother’s silence?

results.title: Pomegranate
results.overview: When an immigrant family is subjected to a daily horror from their past, what will it take to break this cycle and give them a future?

results.title: Four Rational People
results.overview: The Emerson String Quartet embarks on the final season of a fifty-year history that includes 9 GRAMMYs and thousands of concerts. Interweaving vivid memories with delicate observations of life on the road, the film explores the difficult decision to walk away from the things they cherish: the music they play and the friends they hold dear. At once a frank examination of the tyranny of aging and a cri de cœur to pass the torch to a new generation, the film culminates with one final performance, leaving all to ponder what happens to us after the final curtain.

results.title: The Gentle Flutter of the Butterflies
results.overview: Frederico, after losing his partner (Antonio), must cope with the absence and emptiness in the house, while also continuing with his life, preserving the memories of his beloved. Upon discovering his late husband's butterfly collection, he notices an empty space meant for a specific blue butterfly. He devotes the following days to trying to capture the missing butterfly. This journey of discovery causes flowers to bloom from his body.

results.title: Scorching Ping Pong Girls
results.original_title: 卓球少女 -閃光のかなたへ-
